facts.fact: The health ministry's plan lists the national digital economy strategy SN@DEN with a period of 2018-2027 and objectives covering its governance, digital trust, broadband, digital transformation of public administration, economic sectors and society, and human capital; the document does not say whether SN@DEN's own text is published.
